//: Type-checking ONLY. esbuild does the emitting and strips types WITHOUT checking them, which is how `ensureOffscreen is not defined` reached a live page: the orchestrator called an identifier it never imported, and nothing in the build or the suite could notice. `npm run typecheck` is wired into test-all.sh.
//strictNullChecks: ON since 20 Sep, and it REMOVED errors rather than adding them. With it off, `if (!asked.ok)` does NOT narrow a discriminated union — proven on a six-line repro — so every `{ ok: true } | { ok: false }` failure branch in this codebase was UNCHECKED, and the orchestrator's model-failure path read `.reason` and `.detail` off a union that tsc could not confirm had either. Turning it on fixed six errors and surfaced two real ones: a `never[]` inferred from an untyped `[]` that nothing could ever be pushed into. esbuild does not type-check, so this changes no emitted byte — only how much the compiler is allowed to notice.
